0x00083C.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000935.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x0009AF.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000A96.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B0A.en: 「Grr, so this is as far as I go!」

0x000B5F.en: 「Ngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000B9A.en: 「I can't believe I'd blunder in a place like this...!@ This isn't any fun...」

0x000BEE.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000CD8.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D3F.en: 「This is it for me... the rest is on you.」

0x000D71.en: 「Dammit...!@　Is this as far as I go!」

0x000DAD.en: 「Grr! So they got the jump on me...」

0x000DEB.en: 「No good, we've taken too many hits... I'm pulling back!」

0x000E38.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E76.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you all!」

0x000EBD.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F68.en: 「Ngh... so I'm the one who falls like a meteor... I'm ejecting!」

0x00101F.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give. A miscalculation on my part.」

0x0010A4.en: 「U... ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001158.en: 「I'm sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x00118D.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x001279.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still green...!」

0x0012C7.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0013B1.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013EF.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x00141E.en: 「I can't go on any further. Do excuse me.」

0x0014A9.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x00160F.en: 「Ejecting...@ Ngh...! So much for looking cool...」

0x00180D.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x0018DF.en: 「No good, they got me after all.」

0x001911.en: 「Guess I've no choice but to retreat...!」

0x001961.en: Paris - Federation Joint Chiefs of Staff HQ

0x00198F.en: Federation Joint Chiefs of Staff HQ

0x0019F6.en: 「Our attack may have been the trigger...@ but sooner or later, Baral meant to do that anyway.」

0x001A8E.en: 「I'll accept that as your excuse.@ So, what did you want?」

0x001ADE.en: 「As the barrier deployed, the diameter of the Antarctic field shrank,@ and its altitude increased.」

0x001B40.en: 「We believe it changed shape that way to keep the skies@ over the Antarctic from being sealed off.」

0x001BBD.en: 「Perhaps wary of Baral as well,@　the Ruina's movements are settling down.@　You could call this an opportunity for our side.」

0x001C5C.en: 「I see... so this is a nudge, is it.」

0x001C8D.en: 「Yes. I want you to hasten your entry into@ Operation Icebreaker.」

0x001CF8.en: 「We have circumstances of our own here... but very well.@　There is one condition, however.」

0x001D7C.en: 「Hand the Steel Dragon Squadron over to us.」

0x001DAA.en: 「Hand them over or not,@ they are no longer under our jurisdiction.」

0x001E06.en: 「Hmph... then let me rephrase.@ Your side will pursue the Steel Dragons as well.@ But the seizure will be carried out by us.」

0x001EA8.en: 「A rather convenient arrangement...@ but we have our pride to consider as well.」

0x001F0A.en: 「Leave the arrest and handover of the Steel Dragons@　entirely to us.」

0x001F66.en: 「Pride, at this point...@ Are you telling us to call off our pursuit of them?」

0x001FDE.en: (Hmph, fishing for a reaction, are you...@ Not that I'm any different.)

0x002063.en: 「Marshal, are you serious...!?@ Handing the Steel Dragons over to the Gaia Sabers...!」

0x0020DA.en: 「It's a game of deception. Now then,@ let's see how he plays his hand...」

0x00218A.en: 「...The true target was the Nafud Desert after all.」

0x0021BE.en: 「Hmph... things are going so smoothly@ it frightens even me.」

0x00221A.en: 「If Baral's god is enthroned in that Aerial Garden,@ then it too...」

0x002285.en: 「No, we can't be sure yet.@ It may exist in the Antarctic.」

0x002315.en: 「If their king is to awaken,@ Baral's god will move... and that's fine as it is.」

0x00238F.en: 「The problem is Son Ganglong's plan...@ what he means by 'raising the rank of humanity'...」

0x002403.en: 「If that proves a calamity for us,@　we must hasten their completion. The Antarctic can wait.@　Not to mention the Guests.」

0x0024D6.en: 「Yes. Following the example of Bian Zoldark,@　we will stake our lives on bringing this to its conclusion...」

0x002550.en: 「First, deploy the Gamma Saber.@ That will make Gaspard commit.@ All the more so if the Ruina stay still.」

0x00264C.en: 「The barrier from the surfaced 'Garden of Baral' blanketed every sky@ but the Ruina's field... and still holds, even now, it does.」

0x002718.en: 「In sealing off travel between Earth and space,@ it's the same as the Artrum Exterior, but...」

0x0027A1.en: 「As you know, sunlight isn't being blocked, no sir.@ And no especially notable disasters have been@ confirmed anywhere on Earth.」

0x002855.en: 「This barrier's quite gentle on the Earth, isn't it.」

0x002898.en: 「Communication with those in space is currently impossible,@ and we can't reach the Hiryu Kai neither.」

0x00291E.en: 「The barrier's also proven strong enough to withstand@ a direct H-MAPW hit, but...」

0x0029AA.en: 「It's surmised to shrug off even greater than that, yes sir.@ A breakthrough by spatial teleport is likely@ impossible as well.」

0x002A58.en: 「In other words, we've been confined to the Earth once more.」

0x002AB4.en: 「So that barrier is both a shield and a cage.」

0x002AFD.en: 「Son Ganglong means to strip the people of Earth of any refuge before carrying out his mass shikai plan.」

0x002B80.en: 「Ensign Lamia, does Baral's barrier have@ an exit to the outside world,@ like the Septempulm did?」

0x002C0A.en: 「As things stand,@ the Garden of Baral itself is presumed to be one.」

0x002C5D.en: 「Then unless we destroy it,@ we can't leave Earth...?」

0x002CEA.en: 「The risk is quite high, but@ if we pass through the Ruina's field,@ we can escape to space from the Antarctic.」

0x002D6B.en: 「That's a bit too rough. And besides...@ we could pay Son Ganglong a toll to let us through?」

0x002E13.en: 「Don't take her seriously, Ing.@ Anyway, our airspace has been pinned down...」

0x002E78.en: 「Do we carry out Operation Icebreaker in this state,@ or...」

0x002EEC.en: 「On that,@ we await orders from the Joint Chiefs of Staff.」

0x002F39.en: 「Everyone, the situation is abnormal, but...@ don't let it shake you. Carry out the duties@ given to you. That is all.」

0x002FD8.en: 「...Well, it's still better than the Artrum Exterior...@ but somehow it's more unsettling this way.」

0x003067.en: 「Yes... in a way, it's slow torture.」

0x0030BA.en: 「...If it's about Irui, I heard from Sanger.@ She wasn't found, I take it.」

0x003141.en: 「I checked the interior footage too, but...@ there was no sign of anyone like her...」

0x0031A9.en: 「It's as if that girl just@ vanished from inside the room...」

0x003280.en: 「I've no proof, but I've been thinking those demon-sages might well have some technique to spirit Irui away.」

0x003328.en: 「B-but... why would Baral take that girl...!?」

0x003390.en: (Could it be...@ connected to that dream Irui saw...?)

0x0033E3.en: 「...A short while ago, Lieutenant General Jacob sent word@ that the Gaia Sabers have called off their pursuit of us.」

0x00348B.en: 「There was some deal struck between Marshal Gaspard@ and Alteur, but Lieutenant General Jacob himself@ wasn't told the details...」

0x00353C.en: 「That's a hard thing to swallow, right off the bat.」

0x00356A.en: 「The Lieutenant General surmised it may be a measure@ taken on the premise that we'll be joining@ Operation Icebreaker...」

0x003631.en: 「Contact on radar! Ruina units approaching! Straight in from three o'clock! Range five!」

0x0036A9.en: 「All hands, battle stations! Launch all units!」

0x0036EF.en: 「Target groups Alpha and Bravo, straight in from eleven o'clock! Range three!」

0x00377C.en: 「Even with the Earth wrapped in a barrier,@ those guys don't care one bit!」

0x0037D8.en: 「...Whatever Baral does,@ if the 'King of Ruin' awakens, the result is the same.@ That is how the Umbra think.」

0x003890.en: 「I told you before. I was born to fight...@ Even if the foe is the very being that@ created me, what I do won't change.」

0x003941.en: 「But now they know about all of you.」

0x003984.en: 「Yes. The Umbra and Contagio@ will try, without hesitation, to erase us...@ us who serve as your pathfinders.」

0x003A4B.en: 「But you set us free and@ gave us new life. So we'll fight those@ who would erase your existence.」

0x003AED.en: 「Eleve 1 to all units!@ Destroy the Ruina swiftly!」

0x003B43.en: 「Numerous high-speed flying objects, closing on this battle zone!」

0x003BC5.en: 「What, a step too late, were we?」

0x003C60.en: 「When did that man join the Gaia Sabers!?」

0x003CA3.en: 「Don't tell me those guys...@　mean to come after us too!?」

0x003CFC.en: 「No, I heard the Gaia Sabers called off their pursuit of us.」

0x003D5E.en: 「Heh, the prey and the glory are all mine.」

0x003E0D.en: 「I had another job before I got here,@　so I'd like to head home soon.」

0x003E5D.en: 「They're a bigger meal than the Ruina.@　We're going in.」

0x003EDF.en: 「Heh, unlike Albero, this captain actually gets it.」

0x003F2B.en: 「Drink your fill of blood.@　Leave the strong ones worth cutting to me.」

0x003F96.en: 「Fine, I'll do that.@　I'm low on ammo after that last fight anyway.」

0x003FEC.en: 「Like hell I'd waste a chance like that.@　Murata, I'll out-earn you.」

0x004057.en: 「Captain! The Gaia Sabers look ready to come at us!」

0x0040FB.en: 「This is Lt. Cmdr. Tetsuya Onodera,@　captain of the Hagane, Steel Dragon Squadron!@　Didn't you call off your pursuit of us!?」

0x004213.en: 「Save the dreaming for when you're asleep.」

0x004241.en: 「Killing the President's a heavy crime.@　Even your bosses couldn't cover for you forever.」

0x0042C1.en: 「I keep telling you, we were framed!」

0x004344.en: 「Oh yeah? Who, and where?@　Bring 'em on over here.」

0x004387.en: 「...Do you people even grasp the state@　of the Earth Sphere? Right now, the enemy@　we should be fighting is...」

0x004401.en: 「The Ruina and Baral?@　Still no reason to let you off here.」

0x00446F.en: 「Right.@　No one ever ordered the Steel Dragons to stand down anyway.」

0x0044CB.en: 「...You could be lying,@　or you could be telling the truth. Hard to say.」

0x004546.en: 「True enough,@　against a samurai Guarlion and a pack of pups.」

0x004599.en: 「If that man's leading the Gamma Saber, then what is Erde doing now...?」

0x004610.en: 「...Murata, so you're with the Gaia Sabers. Weren't you aiding the remnants of the <Neue DC>?」

0x0046AA.en: 「Since I came back, I've no idea where they are. Eaten by aliens or demons, maybe... either way, my employer now is the Gaia Sabers.」

0x004773.en: 「Do Lt. Cmdr. Onodera's words mean nothing to you?@　This is no time for us to cross blades.」

0x0047F9.en: 「The asura's enlightenment lies beyond a mountain@　of men and machines. If a strong foe stands before me, I cut.」

0x004873.en: 「All the more so if it's you two, Rishu, Sanger.@　That is why I have returned to the surface world.」

0x0048F9.en: 「Absurd. No sword of wicked evil can cut me down.」

0x004936.en: 「You won't stand down, no matter what?」

0x00495E.en: 「I told you once. Empty creeds fall on deaf ears.@　I slake my thirst with blood and machine oil alone.」

0x0049DE.en: 「Don't worry. Once I've finished you off,@　I'll deal with the Ruina and Baral too!」

0x004A4F.en: 「If you're dead set on fighting us,@　I'll take you on after we beat them!」

0x004AC3.en: 「You're bad at begging for your life, Arado!@　We've got no intention of letting you go!」

0x004B62.en: 「...Lt. Cmdr., we've no choice but@　to sweep away the sparks that fall on us.」

0x004BB8.en: 「So be it...! All units, intercept the Gaia Sabers!」

0x004C0E.en: 「Tch, like I'd die in a place like this!@　I'll pay this debt back, count on it!」

0x004C67.en: 「Ngh, you really did a number on me!@　But I'm not about to croak here!」

0x004CDE.en: 「...One battle after another, so this was bound to happen.@　Still, I don't plan on dying.」

0x004D46.en: 「Grah! How dare you do that to my 'Mumyo'!」

0x004DBB.en: 「Rishu, Sanger! I'll leave this bout to you!」

0x004E1D.en: 「Next time we meet, I'll take that head of yours!」

0x004E5D.en: 「My my... his sword's fast, but his retreat's even faster.」

0x004EBF.en: 「Sanger!@　I've been longing for a death-match with you!」

0x004F0F.en: 「A blade of selfish greed won't work on me!@　If you crave the sword that badly,@　go take on the demons of the underworld!」

0x004FA2.en: 「Murata!@　Still can't escape the thrill of killing men!?」

0x004FEF.en: 「A sword exists to cut men down!@　Now my Shishioh runs to sever your life!」

0x00505A.en: 「Rishu's disciple, and a Chokijin too!@　A foe worth cutting! Don't die in a single stroke!」

0x0050DA.en: 「You think that muddied edge of yours@　can cut me and the KoRyuOh down!?」

0x00512D.en: 「...Most likely Alteur buried the order@　to stand down, but I can glimpse Marshal@　Gaspard's intentions in it too.」

0x0051F1.en: 「He probed how they'd respond. Using us as bait.」

0x005247.en: 「Captain, you'd best steel yourself.@　They may well send us on to Grand Christmas@　before the South Pole.」

0x0052F8.en: 「But... the enemy we should be fighting now is...」

0x005338.en: 「They don't see it that way.@　Without a shred of doubt, they'll come at us@　gladly, even eager to draw their blades.」

0x0053D1.en: 「Indeed. Many in the Gaia Sabers have old scores to settle with us.」

0x005433.en: 「But if we act against our arrangement with@　the Federation, we only deepen their suspicions of us.」

0x0054B9.en: 「Perhaps that no longer matters to them.」

0x005518.en: 「Settling their scores with us...@　if that's their true wish...」

0x005577.en: 「Even so, I believe that in a situation like this,@　we should avoid any battle we possibly can.」

0x0055DF.en: 「Just so. Against their unreason,@　that is the spirit one needs.」

0x00564A.en: 「From here on, no matter what foe we face...@　we must not forget our cause, to save the stars from ruin.」

0x0056C1.en: 「Do that, and through every hardship@　we will surely find the path of life, and of right...」

0x0057C3.en: 「Hehehe, not only did they escape erasure,@　they defy us. Just what kind of breakage@　leaves one like that?」

0x005869.en: 「But now the humans have gained@　the means to enter the Meridenplum.」

0x0058CB.en: 「Whether they come here or not, the result is the same.」

0x005908.en: 「But there's Baral to consider...@　For a while, we'd do well to shore up our defenses.」

0x005973.en: 「Their barrier cannot erode this Meridenplum.@　And Baral's god, too, cannot escape@　its fated ruin, hehehe.」

0x005A2D.en: 「Like us, they are ones who sealed away a star.@　We cannot afford to take them lightly.」

0x005A86.en: （Laki... I don't want to see you broken...）

0x005AC9.en: （If you can't be turned back, then with these hands, I'll...）
